total_value.title: Total Value
total_value.description: Total value as Trading212 reports it.

band.title: Band
band.description: Allowed absolute deviation from the target, as a fraction (0.02 = ±2 pp).

CategoryWeightRule.title: CategoryWeightRule
CategoryWeightRule.description: Limit on a category's weight; with no bucket it applies to every bucket of the dimension.

model.title: Model
model.description: Reads report dates off IR calendar pages.

EarningsCalendarSettings.title: EarningsCalendarSettings
EarningsCalendarSettings.description: Next report dates: Finnhub for US issuers, the IR calendar page otherwise.

report_date.title: Report Date
report_date.description: Report date to look for. Default: the instrument's report date if it has passed, else today.

url.title: Url
url.description: Use this document instead of searching (a press release or report).

locate_model.title: Locate Model
locate_model.description: Searches for the release when EDGAR has none (non-US issuers).

max_steps.title: Max Steps
max_steps.description: Claude calls plus document fetches per run.

check_days_after_report.title: Check Days After Report
check_days_after_report.description: Days after the report date on which the check runs until it finds the release (the spec's +1, retry at +2 and +4).

EarningsCheckSettings.title: EarningsCheckSettings
EarningsCheckSettings.description: The earnings thesis check: find the release, extract figures, validate, judge KPIs.

evidence_url.title: Evidence Url
evidence_url.description: Signed URL of the archived copy, valid 10 minutes.

context.title: Context
context.description: The archived text around the snippet.

synced_at.title: Synced At
synced_at.description: When the sync that wrote this snapshot finished its last step.

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: Base-currency units per one unit of `currency`.

ppl.title: Ppl
ppl.description: Unrealised P/L in the account currency (Trading212).

position.description: Null when the latest sync has no position.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Other and former names, used to match news.

results_urls.title: Results Urls
results_urls.description: Pages where results press releases or reports are published.

financial_calendar_url.title: Financial Calendar Url
financial_calendar_url.description: IR financial calendar page with upcoming report dates.

extra_domains.title: Extra Domains
extra_domains.description: Further domains the earnings check may search and fetch from (the IR and results URLs' domains are always allowed).

sec_cik.title: Sec Cik
sec_cik.description: SEC Central Index Key. US issuers (8-K) and foreign issuers that furnish results on 6-K. Looked up from the ticker when empty.

sec_ticker.title: Sec Ticker
sec_ticker.description: Ticker as EDGAR and Finnhub list it, when it differs from the Trading212 ticker's prefix.

fiscal_year_end_month.title: Fiscal Year End Month
fiscal_year_end_month.description: Month the fiscal year ends in (Apple: 9, Microsoft: 6). Maps fiscal quarters to calendar periods.

reporting_currency.title: Reporting Currency
reporting_currency.description: Currency the company reports in; figures in another are held.

HoldingProfilesConfig.title: HoldingProfilesConfig
HoldingProfilesConfig.description: All holding profiles. Stored as `config_version` rows, domain `holding_profiles`.

holdings.title: Holdings
holdings.description: Every open position once, by value descending.

cron.title: Cron
cron.description: Standard 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday).

portfolio_sync.description: Trading212 sync, FX rates and drift. Default: daily at 22:30 Prague time.

earnings_calendar.description: Refresh every holding's next report date. Default: Sundays 06:00.

earnings_due.description: Queue earnings checks for holdings that reported. Default: daily 08:00.

JobsConfig.title: JobsConfig
JobsConfig.description:
Schedules for the worker's timed jobs. Stored as `config_version` rows, domain `jobs`.

The worker re-reads this every few minutes, so a saved change applies without a restart.

history.title: History
history.description: Latest verdict per period, newest first.

freshness.description: Null until the first successful sync.

last_sync.description: The latest sync job, whatever its status.

base_currency_mismatch.title: Base Currency Mismatch
base_currency_mismatch.description: The active strategy's base currency differs from the snapshot's; the next sync converts to the new one.

band.title: Band
band.description: Allowed absolute deviation from the target, as a fraction (0.02 = ±2 pp).

hard_limit.title: Hard Limit
hard_limit.description: Weight above which the position raises an alert, not just a digest flag.

PositionWeightRule.title: PositionWeightRule
PositionWeightRule.description: Limit on a single position's weight; with no ticker it applies to every position.

base_currency.title: Base Currency
base_currency.description: Currency every value is converted to for the overview and allocation.

fx_source.title: Fx Source
fx_source.description: Reference FX rates. Defaults to ČNB for a CZK base currency, ECB otherwise.

weight_basis.title: Weight Basis
weight_basis.description: 'total' weighs positions against positions plus cash; 'invested' against positions only.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free-text guidance the AI reads; never evaluated by code.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Allocation dimensions. 'currency' is derived from the instrument unless a classification overrides it.

classifications.title: Classifications
classifications.description: Bucket per dimension for each holding, e.g. {'ASML_EQ': {'sector': 'Semis'}}.

StrategyConfig.title: StrategyConfig
StrategyConfig.description:
The owner's investment strategy.

Stored as the body of `config_version` rows with domain `strategy`.

band.title: Band
band.description: Allowed absolute deviation from the target, as a fraction (0.02 = ±2 pp).

ThesesConfig.title: ThesesConfig
ThesesConfig.description: All theses. Stored as the body of `config_version` rows, domain `theses`.

exit_conditions.title: Exit Conditions
exit_conditions.description: Conditions that would end the thesis, in plain words.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: Metric name the extraction job looks for.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: What the threshold is in: '%', 'x', 'count', or a currency with an optional scale ('EUR bn', 'USD m', 'USD' for per-share amounts).

ThesisKPI.title: ThesisKPI
ThesisKPI.description: An absolute threshold the owner sets. v1 has no consensus-estimate comparisons.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: One holding, or all when null.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: Judged under an older theses config than the active one; re-run verdicts.

sanity_max_change_qoq.title: Sanity Max Change Qoq
sanity_max_change_qoq.description: A figure that moves more than this fraction against the previous quarter's verified figure is held for review (0.5 = ±50 %). Null disables.

sanity_overrides.title: Sanity Overrides
sanity_overrides.description: Per-metric band replacing the default; null disables the bound for that metric (e.g. seasonal or often sign-changing figures).

stated_ratio_tolerance_pp.title: Stated Ratio Tolerance Pp
stated_ratio_tolerance_pp.description: How far (in percentage points) a ratio the document states may differ from the one recomputed from its raw figures before the stated one is rejected.

period_end_tolerance_days.title: Period End Tolerance Days
period_end_tolerance_days.description: Slack between a stated period end and the calendar month end expected from the fiscal year end (52/53-week fiscal years end on a weekday, not month end).

max_report_lag_days.title: Max Report Lag Days
max_report_lag_days.description: Latest a release may come out after the end of the period it reports.
